content: Decomposing a monolith without a rewrite: put a stable facade in front, keep the external contract fixed, and route capabilities to the new implementation one at a time. For in-process codebase migrations the same logic is Branch by Abstraction. Most failures are not technical: wrong decomposition, the facade accumulating logic and becoming its own monolith, insufficient authority to modernize continuously, and failing to decommission the old code after each extraction, which makes the split cosmetic. Boundaries work best when business, code, deployment and team boundaries roughly agree.
